description: Address code review issues #1, #2, #3, and #7: remove misleading hardcoded KPI trends, flatten nested data for CSV export, apply stored filters on re-download, and normalize layout persistence shape
steps: Fix Issue #1: In DashboardWidgets.jsx KPIContent, remove hardcoded '+5%', '+3%', '+8%' trend percentages or clearly label them as sample/placeholder data.
Fix Issue #2: In ExportCenter.jsx, update CSV generation to flatten nested objects (prefix with parent key) instead of silently dropping them.
Fix Issue #3: In ExportCenter.jsx handleRedownload, apply stored entry.filters when regenerating data.
Fix Issue #7: In storage.js initializeData, store the full layout object for activeDashboardLayout instead of just an ID string to normalize shape.
acceptance_criteria: KPI widgets no longer show misleading percentage changes (or clearly label them as sample data)
CSV export includes flattened nested object fields with dot-notation headers
Re-download from history applies the originally stored filters
activeDashboardLayout is always initialized as a full layout object
npm run lint passes on affected files
verification: Run unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx vite build and confirm exit code 0
Run unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx eslint src/components/reports/ src/lib/storage.js and confirm no errors
